svg.text: hour(t) is t / 3 600 000 000 000, eight lanes at a time
AVX-512: the conversion form, 3 vector ops
vcvtqq2pd and back: one instruction each, and only AVX-512 has them
AVX2: no long-to-double instruction, so the magic form, 14 vector ops
for 0 <= u < 2^52, the bits of u OR 0x4330000000000000, read as a
double, are exactly 2^52 + u: a conversion with no convert instruction.
The same identity, backwards, turns the quotient into a long.
Both forms are exact for every dividend under 2^52; a day is 8.64e13 ns, under 2^47.
